The '''Imperial Court building''' was located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Pesktda]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Garqi/Legends|Garqi]]. [[Dynba Tesc]] was arrested by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces for painting "The Death of a Tyrant is the triumph of Justice!" on the side of the building.<ref name="Missed Chance">{{JournalCite|7|Missed Chance}}</ref>
